name: Tessera Industries Holographic Distraction Projector HDP-5
product_name: Tessera Industries Holographic Distraction Projector HDP-5
description: A throwable device that projects a 3-meter holographic scene — an explosion, a running person, a vehicle crash, or other attention-grabbing event — that lasts for 15 seconds. The HDP-5 is a single-use distraction tool designed to draw attention and surveillance focus to one location while the operator moves through another. The holographic projection includes simulated sound and a thermal signature generator that fools infrared sensors, creating a multi-sensory deception that is convincing for the critical seconds needed to slip past security.
story_hooks: An HDP-5 projecting a fake explosion in a crowded area caused a stampede — the hologram was intended as a distraction for a nearby operation, but the panic resulted in injuries and deaths.
HDP-5 units have been modified to project realistic holographic people that walk, talk, and interact — creating phantom witnesses and suspects that complicate crime scene reconstruction.
